body.p: (task 0.7). xs:integer is unbounded: values that fit int64_t are inline; arithmetic that overflows moves to a cell holding a libmpdec value with exponent 0 (), so there is one arbitrary-precision library, not two. xs:decimal is always a libmpdec cell. Date/time values keep the seven XDM components (local values, optional timezone in minutes) with int64_t year and nanosecond seconds; durations are months plus seconds plus nanoseconds (XDM 4.0, section 5.7 note). Nine fractional digits exceed the required three; more digits are truncated by casting. The public sxml_atomic_datum reads and writes every datum; decimals are exchanged as canonical text, cached in the cell on first read.
